summary.text: John Santanella, a Democrat, has represented District 58 in the Connecticut House of Representatives since January 8, 2025, and advanced from the September 1, 2026 primary to the November ballot.

paragraphs.text: He grew up in Enfield, Connecticut, and earned a bachelor's degree from Boston College in 1990 and a graduate degree in marketing and finance from Boston College in 1997.
His career includes buying and selling small businesses, and earlier work for Parker Brothers, Milton Bradley and Nickelodeon; as of his 2024 campaign he was a member of Enfield's Town Council.
